figures.alt: Engraving of the façade of San Giorgio Maggiore in elevation, with a central pediment on giant columns and lower side wings.
figures.caption: Fig. 1. O. Bertotti Scamozzi, Elevation of San Giorgio Maggiore. Source: Le fabbriche e i disegni di Andrea Palladio, Vol. IV, pl. VIII.

figures.alt: Canaletto painting of the church of San Giorgio Maggiore seen across the water, with its white façade, dome and bell tower and gondolas in front.
figures.caption: Fig. 2. Canaletto, The Church of San Giorgio Maggiore, Venice, ca. 1730–31, oil on canvas. London, private collection. Public domain.

figures.alt: Canaletto capriccio combining the Rialto Bridge and the church of San Giorgio Maggiore beside a canal with boats.
figures.caption: Fig. 3. Canaletto, Capriccio: The Rialto Bridge and the Church of S. Giorgio Maggiore, ca. 1750, oil on canvas. Raleigh, North Carolina Museum of Art, 52.9.149. Public domain.

figures.alt: Woodcut from the Quattro libri: plan and section of the Convento della Carità with its atrium and cloister.
figures.caption: Fig. 4. Palladio, plan and section of the Convento della Carità. Source: Palladio, 1570, Book II, p. 30.

figures.alt: Photograph of the surviving brick façade of the Carità cloister in Venice, with arches on three levels.
figures.caption: Fig. 5. The surviving façade of the Carità cloister. Photo: the author.

figures.alt: Canaletto painting of a monastery courtyard with arcaded brick loggias on three storeys and small figures in the foreground.
figures.caption: Fig. 6. Canaletto, Venice: Caprice View of the Monastery of the Lateran Canons, c. 1743–44, oil on canvas. Royal Collection, RCIN 406991 © Royal Collection Enterprises Limited 2026 | Royal Collection Trust.

figures.alt: Axonometric digital model of the Convento della Carità in yellow lines on a black background, with its plan.
figures.caption: Fig. 7. Digital reconstruction of Palladio’s Convento della Carità. Author’s elaboration.

figures.alt: Perspective analysis of Canaletto's painting: construction lines on a black background linking the painting to the plan and elevations of the cloister.
figures.caption: Fig. 8. Perspective restitution of Canaletto’s painting and comparison with Palladio’s design. Author’s elaboration.

figures.alt: Rendered view of the digital model of the Carità cloister: a brick courtyard with arcades on three levels.
figures.caption: Fig. 9. Perspective view of the digital model of the Carità cloister. Author’s elaboration.

figures.alt: AI-generated image of the cloister courtyard based on Canaletto's capriccio, with brick arcades and a balustrade.
figures.caption: Fig. 10. AI-assisted interpretative visualization of Canaletto’s Capriccio. Author’s elaboration.
